Nobody tells you a software company can run with eight AI agents. Here's one week inside.
Monday, nine A M. A client wants an online saree store. UPI payments and order tracking. Live by Friday.
The product manager agent writes the spec. Catalogue, cart, UPI, tracking. Loyalty points can wait.
The architect agent plans it. Web app, API server, database, and a payment gateway.
The developer agents build it side by side. Frontend, backend, DevOps. Every change gets a code review.
Then the tester agent tries to break it. Empty carts, slow networks, failed payments. Every bug goes back to the developers.
The security agent checks payments and customer data. Then the release agent ships it live.
But one desk is still human. You. You approve the spec, the design, and the release.
